tspan.tspan: Food is 46% of India’s consumer price index
Weights of the CPI basket, All‐India, rural and urban combined, out of 100.
Weights from MOSPI’s 2012 base, drawn from the 2011–12 household consumption survey. Each square
The grid has 100 squares, one for each point of weight in the price index. Food fills 46
of them, so a change in food prices moves the index more than anything else.
